presentation.instructions: An industrial research blacksite above six buried machinery districts. One continuous 3×3 complex: all twelve neighbouring edges have traversable connections. Enter from Slag Approach, cross the lab, descend through Containment Choir and the warrens, then circle the lowest works and climb toward the eastern wasteland. A/D move; hold Space to rise, release to descend. F follows the player, arrows pan, P animates, F8 gives a clean view. Tile views preserve the whole world and your edits. R restores all nine tiles together. Starts paused.
